[PAPER_0073, relevance_score=0.321] Results and Discussion

Manipulation Check

Consistent with the prior studies, participants in the mating condition (M = 3.17, SD = 2.11) reported higher levels of mating motivation than those in the control condition (M = 1.38, SD = 0.92), F(1, 463) = 140.04, p < .001, ηp2 = .232, 95% CI [1.498, 2.095].

[PAPER_0074, relevance_score=0.273] Help-Providers' Romantic Interests

Data were submitted to an ANOVA by treating condition (mating vs. control) and type of requested help (dependency-oriented vs. autonomy-oriented) as between-subject factors. The interaction between condition and type of requested help was significant, F(1, 461) = 7.44, p = .007, ηp2 = .016, 95% CI [0.226, 1.391].

[PAPER_0080, relevance_score=0.296] Sense of Power
